content: Standard GitHub Actions -> ECR -> ECS Fargate pipeline: checkout, configure-aws-credentials via OIDC (no long-lived keys), aws-actions/amazon-ecr-login, docker build+tag with commit SHA, push to ECR, aws-actions/amazon-ecs-render-task-definition to inject new image into task def JSON, aws-actions/amazon-ecs-deploy-task-definition to update the service (rolling deploy). OIDC federation strongly preferred over static AWS access keys in repo secrets.
